Direct and inverse proportion

Direct proportion · Direct or inverse? · Inverse proportion

by Hasan

Thursday

🎯 Today’s objective

By the end of this lesson I can...

✓ I can use direct proportion (find one first)

✓ I can tell direct from inverse proportion

✓ I can use inverse proportion (more workers, less time)

So you can tell when more means more, and when more means less!
